headline: Polycab India Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process - Polycab India Limited has informed the Exchange that Hon''ble NCLAT has granted the request for early listing and the appeal is now scheduled to be held on October 15, 2026.
